result.summary: The page is mostly functional, but there are a few visual/layout concerns: horizontally scrolling content is clipped at the right edge without clear affordance, some imagery has low-contrast overlay controls, and one promotional badge uses ambiguous wording.

issues.description: The rightmost items in the category chips and 'Fastest near you' carousel are cut off at the viewport edge, and the restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' is truncated without a clear ellipsis or fade affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add edge fades, partial-card peeking with consistent padding, or horizontal scroll indicators so clipped content reads as intentionally scrollable rather than broken.

issues.description: The heart/favorite icons on dark restaurant images are thin dark outlines with limited contrast against the photo background.
issues.suggestion: Use a filled or higher-contrast icon style, add a subtle scrim behind overlay controls, or increase stroke/background contrast.

issues.description: The '-100%' badge on the lower pizza card is ambiguous and may look like an error rather than a promotion.
issues.suggestion: Clarify the offer text, e.g. '100% off delivery' or 'Free item', and align badge styling with other promo labels.
